stages.label: Ordinary laboratory state
required_visible: Recognisable adult fictional face and body
stages.notes: Extract baseline identity frame at 3.0 seconds.

stages.label: Serum activation
required_visible: Clear causal action with vial or serum apparatus
First subtle skin flush or vascular response
stages.notes: Make the causal event unambiguous without a hard cut.

stages.label: Onset of continuous growth
required_visible: Fabric tension appears at shoulders and chest

camera.framing: Maintain face, shoulders and chest together

stages.label: Early continuous growth
required_visible: Balanced bilateral pectoral growth in width, projection and thickness
Clothing stress increases without obscuring anatomical continuity

camera.movement: Slow lateral move with deliberate holds
camera.framing: Preserve face and connected shoulder-chest-arm anatomy
camera.continuity: No hard cuts in the growth passage

stages.notes: Extract continuity frame at 25.0 seconds. This is a semantic interval, not a separate render state.

stages.label: Main continuous growth passage
required_visible: Chest becomes dominant while remaining bilaterally balanced
Clothing stretches and begins to fail
All intimate anatomy remains non-explicit and covered

camera.description: Lingering medium and close-to-medium views with periodic full-body scale checks
camera.framing: Alternate detail emphasis with readable body-to-room scale
camera.continuity: No hard cuts; match all camera movement to the continuous deformation

stages.notes: Extract continuity frame at 42.0 seconds. Regional growth curves must overlap smoothly rather than activate as discrete jumps.

stages.label: Escalation and environmental failure
required_visible: Clothing rupture or severe distortion handled non-explicitly
Secondary settling motion in skin and musculature
Subject visibly exceeds the original spatial and wardrobe scale

camera.description: Wider scale-revealing view with brief matched detail emphasis
camera.framing: Subject and laboratory architecture share the frame
camera.continuity: Preserve one continuous transformation state across reframing

stages.notes: No graphic nudity; preserve coverage and keep environmental reaction subordinate to the continuous body event.

stages.label: Terminal hyper-form hold
required_visible: Final pose readable for the full hold
New scale remains legible against laboratory environment

camera.movement: Slow pull-back resolving into a hold
camera.continuity: Hold through final frame; no early cutaway

growth.rate: settled new baseline with residual breathing

stages.notes: The ending is a new baseline, not an unresolved continuation.

identity_locks.notes: Frame paths are planned extraction targets, not files already generated. Confirm adult fictional subject identity and continuity before production.

continuity_policy.notes: One continuous morph across 60 seconds. The seven stages are descriptive timing overlays, not hard cuts or independent model swaps. If a technical reframing is required, preserve the exact growth state and temporal interpolation.

claims.claim: All seven stages and their time ranges are a user-provided production example, not extracted timings from an existing Hulum's Cave video.
claims.notes: Treat as production design, not historical source analysis.
